notes: Site: anthropologie.com/en-gb/ (genuine distinct UK storefront, GBP pricing). Access: DataDome-protected; direct HTTP (curl_cffi) and Playwright/CDP both got IP-blocked with a DataDome CAPTCHA page after a handful of requests, so this was completed via Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) on the user's real Chrome session. Scoped to Home department (Home & Decor + Furniture top-nav departments). SALE VS CLEARANCE JUDGMENT CALL: the site has NO page anywhere in its nav, category sitemap, or on-page copy that uses the words 'Clearance', 'Outlet', 'Final Sale', 'Last Chance', or 'End of Line' -- every discount listing is labelled purely 'Sale' (top-nav item 'Sale', breadcrumbs 'Sale / Sale Home & Decor', 'Sale / Sale Furniture', H1s like 'Sale Homeware', 'Sale Furniture'). On-page marketing copy leans promotional/temporary ('Catch these charming homeware treasures at Anthropologie while you can', 'Shop Our Best Deals On Sale', 'Shop from pillowcases... you won't find anywhere else') with no explicit permanent-markdown/outlet/discontinued-stock language. However this is NOT a one-off named campaign (no 'Black Friday'/'Summer Sale' branding) -- it is an evergreen, continuously-live 'Sale' section of the site with its own full multi-level category taxonomy (Sale > Sale Home & Decor > Bedding/Books & Stationery/Candles & Room Décor/Kitchen & Dining/Knobs Hooks and Handles/Lighting/Soft Furnishings, and the sibling Sale > Sale Furniture), which is the structural pattern many retailers use as a de facto permanent-clearance mechanism even without the word 'Clearance'. Given the brief's explicit guidance to record rather than silently exclude when genuinely uncertain, every row below is recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW: AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE flag rather than guessing. Site-wide /en-gb/sale (1358 products, all departments incl. Clothing/Beauty) was excluded as out of Home-department scope; /en-gb/sale-home-1 and other odd single-item sitemap URLs (sale-home-hardware showed only 1 live product) were checked and are genuine (if small) live listings, not broken pages. Sub-structure: 'Sale Home & Decor' (143) has 7 confirmed real children reached via its own in-page 'Shop by Category' dropdown (Bedding, Books & Stationery, Candles & Room Décor, Kitchen & Dining, Knobs/Hooks/Handles, Lighting, Soft Furnishings) -- listed as a parent + children group; child counts sum to more than the parent (171 vs 143) because products legitimately appear in multiple sub-categories, which is expected overlap, not an error. 'Sale Furniture' (88) is a separate sibling branch under the Furniture department (no further children found -- its own page has no 'Shop by Category' dropdown, only flat Product Type/Price/Colour filters). /en-gb/sale-furniture-under-200 (a price-filtered slice, not a genuine distinct category) was excluded as an arbitrary filter page.
